26: Fix: the recording of a running livestream missing from the channel's videos;
Fix: channel search with names of more than one word;
Fix: login not completing, which made subscription import fail;
Fix: cookie banner blocking the login page on Android;
Fix: subscription import only brought in the first 5 followed channels;
Fix: subscription import with an expired login now says to log in again instead of showing a 401 error;
Fix: live chat not receiving new messages;
Fix: Home feed repeating the same streams when scrolling;
Fix: missing thumbnails for live streams;
Fix: thumbnails of VODs saved before version 25 disappearing after a few minutes;
Fix: live streams showing the time they were opened instead of their start time;
Fix: links to a channel's About or Videos tab opening the wrong channel;
Fix: error when searching channels with only spaces;
Fix: removed the channel page search box, which always failed (Kick has no search within a channel);
25: Fix: VOD links shared from Grayjay opening a not-found page on kick.com;
Fix: VOD links copied from kick.com not opening;
24: Fix: some VODs not playing when opened from a channel page (channels with capitals or spaces in their name);
Fix: channel search with special characters;
22: Fix: reflexion issue logging exceptions in desktop;
19: Improvement: retry all requests at least 3 times;
18: Improvement: When playing livestreams show featured streams as recommendations. Otherwise show previous streams from the channel;
17: Fix: Safer username extraction from URLs;
Fix: Proper URL generation while sharing previous streamed videos;
Fix: Deeplinking previous streammed videos from Kick's website;
